text: The Frontier Guard musters here, defending their homeland.
The Frontier Guard stands in disciplined ranks, morale high as the heavens, making them impossible for the enemy to assail.
Countless military orders are issued from here, much like the central mind of Cathay's vast war machine.

A tall tower at Blood Wind Keep that has stood unyielding through countless tides of Chaos. Its beacon fire burns without cease through all the seasons, said to be visible even from the distant Great Bastion. Its very existence stands as the finest proof of the wisdom and courage of Cathay's people.

Both stable and prison for convicts, these men have willingly forsaken a swift and simple death to embrace the fate of living weapons. They and their warhorses are the last resort to hold back the enemy horde before Cathay's regular forces arrive. These lunatics laden with explosives strike fear not only into the enemy, but into their fellow Cathayan soldiers as well.
Roads carefully paved with crushed stone and lime, easing the way for travellers. Maintaining the safety and stability of these roads is likewise one of the duties of Cathay's officials.

Cathay's many cities are linked together by broad highways, patrolled regularly by Cathayan soldiers to ensure the safety of travellers. To Cathay, these roads are no different from its very veins, granting the empire its vitality.

Imperial Highways are roads built to the highest standard in Cathay, with roadbeds a hundred paces wide and routes laid perfectly straight, built for the transport of armies. Along their sides even slumbering Terracotta Guardians stand watch.
